class View:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows = []
        self.notes = {}
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None
        self.seq = 0
        self.latest_request_id = None
    
    def begin(self, query):
        self.seq += 1
        self.latest_request_id = self.seq
        self.loading = True
        self.error = None  # Clear loading errors but keep rows until valid finish
        return self.seq
    
    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        if not isinstance(rows, list):
            rows = list(rows) if hasattr(rows, '__iter__') else [rows]
        
        # Only accept if this is the latest request AND it hasn't been finished yet
        if request_id != self.latest_request_id:
            return False
        
        # Mark as no longer loading and store the rows (make a copy)

from view import View

def test_begin_increases_sequence():
    v = View()
    assert v.begin('q1') == 1
    assert v.begin('q2') == 2
    assert v.begin('q3') == 3
    print('test_begin_increases_sequence PASSED')

def test_finish_accepts_latest():
    v = View()
    vid1 = v.begin('q1')
    vid2 = v.begin('q2')
    # First finish should succeed
    assert v.finish(vid2, [1, 2, 3]) == True
    assert v.rows == [1, 2, 3]
    print('test_finish_accepts_latest PASSED')

def test_finish_rejects_old():
    v = View()
    vid1 = v.begin('q1')
    vid2 = v.begin('q2')
    # Finish with old ID should fail
    assert v.finish(vid1, [99]) == False
    # Rows should still be empty or unchanged
    print('test_finish_rejects_old PASSED')

def test_finish_rejects_duplicate():
    v = View()
    vid = v.begin('q1')
    # Finish twice with same ID - second should fail
    assert v.finish(vid, [1]) == True
    assert v.finish(vid, [2]) == False
    print('test_finish_rejects_duplicate PASSED')

def test_begin_clears_error():
    v = View()
    v.error = 'old error'
    vid = v.begin('new query')
    assert v.error is None
    print('test_begin_clears_error PASSED')

def test_begin_keeps_rows_until_finish():
    v = View()
    # Simulate some rows existing (edge case)
    import copy
    old_rows = [1, 2]
    v.rows = old_rows
    vid = v.begin('q')
    # Rows should still be there until finish
    assert v.rows == old_rows
    print('test_begin_keeps_rows_until_finish PASSED')

def test_loading_exposed():
    v = View()
    assert not v.loading
    vid = v.begin('q')
    assert v.loading == True
    # After successful finish
    v.finish(vid, [])
    assert not v.loading
    print('test_loading_exposed PASSED')

def test_finish_accepts_rows_copy():
    v = View()
    rows = [1, 2, 3]
    vid = v.begin('q')
    result = v.finish(vid, rows)
    assert result == True
    # Modify original and check view.rows unchanged
    rows.append(999)
    assert v.rows == [1, 2, 3]
    print('test_finish_accepts_rows_copy PASSED')

def test_notes_preserved():
    v = View()
    vid1 = v.begin('q1')
    v.notes['job1'] = 'note1'
    vid2 = v.begin('q2')
    assert v.notes == {'job1': 'note1'}  # Notes preserved through begin
    print('test_notes_preserved PASSED')

def test_finish_doesnt_clear_notes():
    v = View()
    vid = v.begin('q')
    v.notes['job'] = 'my note'
    v.finish(vid, [1])
    assert v.notes == {'job': 'my note'}
    print('test_finish_doesnt_clear_notes PASSED')

def test_empty_rows_handling():
    v = View()
    vid = v.begin('q')
    result = v.finish(vid, [])
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == []
    print('test_empty_rows_handling PASSED')

def test_begin_returns_monotonic():
    v = View()
    ids = [v.begin(f'q{i}') for i in range(10)]
    for i in range(len(ids) - 1):
        assert ids[i] < ids[i+1], f'Sequence not monotonic: {ids}'
    print('test_begin_returns_monotonic PASSED')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_begin_increases_sequence()
    test_finish_accepts_latest()
    test_finish_rejects_old()
    test_finish_rejects_duplicate()
    test_begin_clears_error()
    test_begin_keeps_rows_until_finish()
    test_loading_exposed()
    test_finish_accepts_rows_copy()
    test_notes_preserved()
    test_finish_doesnt_clear_notes()
    test_empty_rows_handling()
    test_begin_returns_monotonic()
    print('\nAll tests passed!')
